items.asset_role: Linux application server and vulnerability scanner
items.title: Apache Log4j2 JNDI remote code execution (Log4Shell)
items.solution: Upgrade log4j-core to 2.17.1 or later and restart the application.
items.reasons: listed in CISA KEV (known exploited); KEV entry linked to a known ransomware campaign; internet-facing asset; EPSS 0.97 (elevated exploit probability); CVSS 10.0
